info.title: Tools — cat-harness-tools
info.description: The call contracts of the harness's Tools, one operation per Tool, generated from the Tool nodes (`schemas/tools/tool.ts`) so standard API tooling can read them. **No HTTP server serves these paths**: each Tool is reached as its `x-invoke` says — a command line, an MCP tool, or an in-process call. Tags are the skills each Tool satisfies.

post.description: Run a declared BPMN process as an instance: `workflow_start` opens one for a subject, `workflow_next` reports what is enabled, `workflow_complete` records a step or answers a decision (a DMN-computed one from `facts`) and REFUSES a step that is not enabled. State is committed under the work plan, so which edge was taken is a record, not a memory.

process.description: The process to run: a diagram's file stem or its `bpmn:process` id.

node.description: The step or decision to complete, as `workflow_next` reported it.

enabled.description: What may be worked next, after each call.

x-selection.when: Work follows a declared process and its order must be enforced and recorded: a step done out of order should be refused, not just discouraged.
x-selection.limits: Reached over MCP; an agent without the server can walk the generated checklist (`bpmn-checklist`) by hand, but nothing then refuses a wrong turn.
x-selection.cost: One diagram load per call; state is a small committed file.

NodeId.description: A node id within a BPMN process, e.g. A_Implement

ProcessId.description: A BPMN process id, e.g. crdm-requirements
